description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 29.12.2025 to 04.01.2026
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs notification issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It announces new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This falls squarely under the definition of a **Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5)**, as it pertains to the implementation of a regulatory framework (customs law) through a statutory instrument. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, etc.
